observedMismatches.userObservation: The official site does not visibly use orange as a core or database action color.
observedMismatches.whyPreviousGatePassed: An authored approved-pattern phrase, orange search, was treated as evidence even though site-evidence contains no rendered orange observation or computed value.
observedMismatches.requiredResolution: Remove the unsupported role from intent, approved patterns, preview copy, adapter and Brand MOD; do not replace it with a guessed color.

observedMismatches.userObservation: The Home Indicator on the Pokémon Button style page appears as a white footer block.
observedMismatches.whyPreviousGatePassed: The shared indicator probe covered source-schema pages but not style/component showcase phones.
observedMismatches.requiredResolution: Make the outer indicator a transparent absolute chassis overlay for every normal phone preview and add a style-page regression probe.

observedMismatches.userObservation: A phone that has a TabBar must not leave the Home Indicator surface transparent; it should visually continue the adjacent TabBar background.
observedMismatches.whyPreviousGatePassed: The previous correction asserted one transparent normal-mode surface for every route. Its probe checked indicator position, visibility and transparency, but did not branch on the phone's bottom-action structure or compare the Indicator background with the adjacent TabBar background.
observedMismatches.requiredResolution: Model bottom actions as an explicit phone chassis state. Keep the Indicator transparent only when there is no TabBar; when a TabBar exists, continue its default or themed background through the Indicator area. Proof modes remain hidden. Add surface-continuity and geometry checks to the implementation test matrix.
